anti_patterns.message: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
anti_patterns.remediation: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' step 3 uses unpinned action 'gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4.0.1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
